text: Diagnosis and treatment at a government hospital under the Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY scheme should not require money at the counter [3]. Screening under the National Programme for Prevention and Control of Non-Communicable Diseases is free at sub-centres and Ayushman Bharat Health and Wellness Centres [6]. Tuberculosis testing and treatment under the National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme are also free [6]. If you are asked for money at the government hospital, that is worth questioning [3].
